text:
priya: Heads up — noticed users from @corp-analytics still have decrypt access to KMS CMK after SCIM deprovisioning yesterday. :warning:
alex: that sounds bad. which key? can you paste audit log snippet?
priya: key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abc-1234-ffff-eeee — CloudTrail shows Decrypt calls at 2026-03-19T22:03:14Z from user principal `svc-analytics-prod` even after their group was removed.
jordan: did we recently change group-to-role mappings in the RBAC refactor last week? I remember we merged `analytics-read` -> `analytics-basic`.
maya: yes, on Friday we changed mapping rules in rbac-service: https://git.redwood/repo/changeset/4321 — it introduced new `group_to_role` canonicalization.
priya: repro steps I ran:
```
# list current SCIM mapping
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://scim.redwood.internal/v2/Groups?filter=displayName eq "corp-analytics"
# check iam role policy
aws iam get-role-policy --role-name AnalyticsDecryptRole --policy-name KMSAccess
# audit - CloudTrail
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=arn:aws:kms:abc-1234 --max-results 5
```
alex: hmm. possible race: SCIM deprovision removed users from the group but RBAC refactor changed the canonical role name so the mapping engine created an extra ephemeral RoleBinding? Could be leftover service principal binding.
sam: I ran `aws kms list-grants --key-id abc-1234` and see a grant to `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/AnalyticsDecryptRole` created on 2026-03-19T21:58:23Z
priya: but the role was supposed to get removed when the group lost all members. looks like deprovision hook didn't run for role cleanup.
maya: the scim-worker logs show a 500 at 21:58 during `apply_role_changes` — stacktrace snippet:
```
error: upsertRoleBinding failed: conflict on roleName normalized -> "analytics.basic"
panic: failed to rollback
```
jordan: that might have aborted cleanup while leaving IAM grants intact. the IAM grant is independent from RBAC store so it persists.
alex: mitigation: rotate the CMK key policy to remove the role, then delete the orphaned IAM grant. I'll open an infra ticket to rotate and revoke grants.
priya: putting this as P1 for audit/compliance. we need to: 1) remove grants, 2) fix scim-worker rollback, 3) run a reconciliation job to detect orphaned role bindings -> IAM grants.
sam: I can run a one-off reconcile: `tools/scim-reconcile --dry-run --since=2026-03-18` to enumerate diffs.
maya: created CICD PR #457 to add retry + idempotent rollback in scim-worker. also added extra audit log emit when rollback happens.
jordan: let's also add a check in post-deprov hook to explicitly revoke KMS grants for roles that are being removed; small script can call `aws kms revoke-grant`.
priya: noted. tagging @compliance for records. @alex please coordinate key rotation and runbook.
alex: on it. I'll post updates here once rotated and grants revoked.
deploy-bot: canary deploy of scim-worker v1.12.3 -> prod started 2026-03-20T02:10:00Z
priya: thanks. after grants are revoked we should run an audit to confirm no decrypt logs from removed principals for 24h.
maya: filed ticket SEC-2026-198 with action items, assigning to alex/sam/maya.
priya: ok, thanks team. keeping thread open until revoke + reconciliation complete. :lock:
